001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.simple.props;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
008import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
009
010/**
011 * Makes {@link SimpleProperties} provide properties to RainbowGum.
012 * <p>
013 * If a {@link SimpleProperties} is already bound in the {@link ServiceRegistry} (for
014 * example an application put one there with a custom
015 * {@link SimpleProperties.Builder#envPrefix(String) envPrefix}/
016 * {@link SimpleProperties.Builder#resource(String) resource} before RainbowGum
017 * initializes) it is used instead of the default {@link SimpleProperties#builder()
018 * SimpleProperties.builder().build()}.
019 */
020@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
021public final class SimplePropertiesProvider implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.PropertiesProvider {
022
023        /**
024         * For service loader.
025         */
026        public SimplePropertiesProvider() {
027        }
028
029        @Override
030        public List<LogProperties> provideProperties(ServiceRegistry registry) {
031                var simpleProperties = registry.putIfAbsent(SimpleProperties.class, () -> SimpleProperties.builder().build());
032                return simpleProperties.properties();
033        }
034
035}
